A '''tree slug''' was a type of creature. The acronym of [[Undersecretary to the Assistant Secretary to the Acting Chief of Information for Senator Wren|the title]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] functionary [[Horil Damlo]] was phonetically close to the [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] word for a [[Species/Legends|species]] of tree slug.
